name: Thomas
title: The Doubter Who Confessed
summary: Thomas, also called Didymus (the Twin), was one of Jesus' twelve apostles. He is known as 'the doubter' because he refused to believe in the resurrection until he had seen and touched Jesus' wounds. When Jesus appeared to him, he confessed: 'My Lord and my God!'

keyEvents.title: Let Us Die with Him
keyEvents.description: When Jesus intended to go to Judea despite the danger, Thomas courageously said to the others: 'Let us go, so that we may die with him!'

keyEvents.title: The Question about the Way
keyEvents.description: At the Last Supper, Thomas asked: 'Lord, we do not know where you are going. How then can we know the way?'

keyEvents.title: Doubt
keyEvents.description: Thomas was not present when Jesus first appeared and said he would not believe until he could see and touch the wounds.

keyEvents.title: My Lord and My God
keyEvents.description: Eight days later, Jesus appeared and invited Thomas to put his fingers into the wounds. Thomas confessed: 'My Lord and my God!'

keyEvents.title: Blessed are those who believe
keyEvents.description: Jesus said to Thomas: 'Because you have seen me, you believe. Blessed are those who have not seen and yet believe.'
